earnings.title: CURTISS-WRIGHT REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS AND RAISES FULL-YEAR 2026 GUIDANCE
highlights: Reported sales of $953 million, up 10%, operating income of $188 million , operating margin of 19.7%, and diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $3.77;
Adjusted operating income of $189 million, up 11%;
Adjusted operating margin of 19.9%, up 30 basis points;
Free cash flow (FCF) of $157 million, generating 108% FCF conversion;

quotes.text: Curtiss-Wright delivered a strong third quarter, highlighted by double-digit growth in both revenue and operating income, and mid-teens growth in adjusted diluted EPS, as we continue to execute on the strength of our product portfolio.

outlook: Entering 2027, the Company expects to have remaining open repurchase authorization of $600 million; and
(2) 2026 Free Cash Flow guidance includes higher year-over-year growth in capital expenditures supporting growth and efficiency, and strong free cash flow conversion in excess of 105%.
